findings.observation: [Direct] The frozen Simulator journey turns one reviewed Signal into one exact, owned internal action and records a revisioned observed outcome with canonical readback and zero external effects. [Supported inference] That should reduce lost follow-up context, but the artifact has no design-partner comparison showing that recruiters complete this loop faster or with fewer corrections than notes, ATS, email, or calendar workarounds.

findings.recommendation: Before claiming production workflow efficiency, complete physical-device capture and manual VoiceOver runs plus five credentialed pinned-model Claude trials using the frozen evaluator, recording correction and abandonment burden.
findings.verification: The complete critical journey remains reachable and truthful on hardware with VoiceOver, and all five live trials either stage one evidence-supported review-only Proposal or durable no_action with no external effect.

strengths: [Direct] Hash verification passed for all 195 frozen source entries, 14 evidence entries, 21 screenshots, both atomic ledgers, and the aggregate source digest; this review therefore addresses TS-V1-FINAL-20260824-03 rather than a moving worktree.

[Direct] The complete local momentum loop is closed: Capture preserves source first, exact Person/Pursuit/context identity is explicitly selected, evidence and uncertainty are visible, a revision-checked Proposal changes canonical Pursuit state only after item review, one owner records an internal observed outcome, and both writes have canonical receipts/readback.

[Direct] Same-name handling does not rely on display name: the frozen receipt exposes distinct Person, role, context, Capture, and resource identifiers, while backend and iOS checks keep the identity unresolved until an explicit selection.

[Direct] Today orders work rather than people, carries target outcome, target date, blocker, evidence availability, owner, due work, and recent outcome, and source tests prove attention-bearing Pursuits are not hidden after an arbitrary third item.

[Direct] Response loss fails visibly closed for both Proposal review and owned-action completion, then relaunch reconciles the same persisted operation without a second POST; evidence-review authority also binds the exact predecessor review and makes a stale operation terminal rather than retryable.

[Direct] Source deletion removes/redacts source-derived Proposal narrative and canaries, supersedes open review authority, preserves attributable historical user decisions without calling unavailable evidence current, and the Ask handoff opens the exact cited Pursuit action.

[Direct rubric trace] Trigger relevance 3, capture burden 3, evidence review 3, state integrity 3, action usefulness 3, write safety 3, interruption recovery 3, and wedge discipline 3. The reported score is the lowest material dimension, not an average; every 4-level anchor remains withheld without field or broader recovery evidence.
